Dipolog Localized 24-Hour Forecast bookmark

Writes the localized forecast post for Zamboanga Peninsula and Misamis Occidental (English and Cebuano) from PAGASA Mindanao's latest regional forecast, with astronomical information over Dipolog City.

⛅ DIP Forecast

Install: drag the blue button onto Chrome's bookmarks bar.
Bookmarks bar hidden? Press ⌘ Shift B.

If dragging doesn't work: then right-click the bookmarks bar → Add page…, name it DIP Forecast, and paste into the URL box.

Use
  1. Open pagasa.dost.gov.ph (any PAGASA page). Click the bookmark anywhere else and it offers to take you there.
  2. Click DIP Forecast. A panel opens with the post text and the satellite GIF.
  3. Check the text (edit it in the box if needed), then Copy text and paste into your Facebook post.
  4. To attach the satellite animation: Open GIF to save, right-click it → Save Image As…, and add that file to the post.

Fill in the heat index blanks from your local records before posting. If any Cebuano wording could not be translated it stays in English and the panel shows a red warning. Rise and set times are calculated for Dipolog City.
